cameraRules.aspectRatioStandard: 4:5 Vertical Portrait (512x640 Default) matching Instagram Feed
cameraRules.framingStandard: Flexible Framing Standard: Close-up Portrait (40-50% face) for Profile Avatars/Stories; Medium / 3/4 Body Shot for Feed Posts, Outfits, and Cutscenes.
cameraRules.lightingStandard: Soft diffused wrapping light, volumetric rim light, smooth airbrush gradient shading.
cameraRules.cameraFilterStandard: No camera/film terms (ARRI, 35mm grain, sensor noise).
cameraRules.backgroundGuard: Describe scenes plainly (e.g. 'cozy bedroom at night, soft dim warm bedside lamp glow'). Do not add 'painted webtoon' prefixes; the golden-master look uses soft semi-real backgrounds.
cameraRules.negativeGuard: Negative prompt has NO effect (CFG 1 + ConditioningZeroOut). Steer only with positive wording.
cameraRules.compositionRule: The reference locks composition: front-facing, upper body to hips. Write poses inside that frame (standing, sitting, hands near face, holding small objects). Lying down, full body, side/back views do not render.
